architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages map 1:1 to Stitch screens. Shared UI components extracted from common patterns. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management library (use React context for global state).

tickets.title: Create OnboardingStepsWidget page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch onboarding_steps_widget screen to React component. Extract reusable StepIndicator component. Use Tailwind for layout and spacing. Match design pixel-perfect.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind classes match Stitch spacing, colors, typography

tickets.title: Create OnboardingStepsWebViewFixedTokens page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch onboarding_steps_web_view_fixed_tokens screen. Reuse StepIndicator from TASK-001. Add WebView component for embedded content. Fixed token display area with copy-to-clipboard functionality.

tickets.title: Create ButtonShowcaseWebViewFinal page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button_showcase_web_view_final screen. Extract reusable Button component with variants (primary, secondary, disabled, loading). Showcase all button states. WebView component reused from TASK-002.

tickets.title: Create ButtonShowcaseMobile page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button_showcase_mobile screen. Reuse Button component from TASK-003. Mobile-specific layout adjustments. Touch targets meet WCAG 2.1 AA (minimum 48x48px).

tickets.title: Extract shared layout components
tickets.description: Identify common layout patterns across all screens. Extract Header, Footer, Container components. Ensure consistent spacing, typography, color scheme.
acceptance_criteria: No layout duplication in page components

tickets.title: Create global theme and design tokens
tickets.description: Extract design tokens from Stitch screens. Create theme.js with colors, spacing, typography, breakpoints. Tailwind config extends theme. Ensure all components use theme variables.
acceptance_criteria: Theme variables match Stitch design system
No hardcoded colors, spacing, or typography

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create App shell. Set up React Router with routes for all pages. Add navigation bar with active state. Ensure lazy loading for pages. Error boundary at root level.
